input.quote: NOTWITHSTANDING THE FOREGOING, NOTHING IN THIS SECTION 16.5 IS INTENDED TO OR SHALL LIMIT OR RESTRICT THE AMOUNTS PAYABLE TO THIRD PARTIES UNDER THE INDEMNITIES PROVIDED PURSUANT TO ARTICLE 10, SECTIONS 16.1 AND 16.2 ABOVE; PROVIDED, FURTHER, THAT THE FOREGOING LIMITATION OF LIABILITY SHALL NOT APPLY IN THE CASE OF GROSS NEGLIGENCE OR WILLFUL MISCONDUCT.
input.rationale: Section 16.5 (p0727) is a mutual exclusion of special, indirect, punitive, incidental and consequential damages with carve-outs for the Article 10 / Sections 16.1-16.2 indemnities and for gross negligence and willful misconduct, but no monetary aggregate cap exists anywhere in the Agreement (Section 17.3(d) at p0751 only bars the tribunal from awarding punitive or excess damages), so each Party's direct-damages liability is unlimited. That fails the fallback's material requirement of a mutual 12 months' fees cap and is materially adverse to Ono, which carries the commercialization and product-liability indemnity risk for the Ono Territory under Section 16.1. We therefore insert a new Section 16.6 at the preferred position: a mutual cap at the greater of the fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000, with uncapped confidentiality, data protection and security, indemnification, gross negligence, willful misconduct, fraud and IP-infringement claims, and confirming Customer's payment obligations are not damages for cap purposes.

ops.text: Cap on Aggregate Liability. Except in respect of Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of (a) the fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and (b) USD 1,000,000. "Excluded Claims" means a Party's breach of its confidentiality obligations under Article 10, its data protection or security obligations, its indemnification obligations under Sections 16.1 and 16.2, its gross negligence, willful misconduct or fraud, and its infringement of the other Party's intellectual property rights. Customer's payment obligations, including all amounts due under this Agreement, are not damages for purposes of the foregoing cap.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 16.5 waives consequential damages but leaves each Party's direct liability entirely uncapped, so we have added a mutual aggregate cap at the greater of the fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim and USD 1,000,000. Confidentiality, data protection and security, indemnification, gross negligence, willful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement sit outside the cap, and Customer's payment obligations are not damages for cap purposes.
proposal.summary: Add a mutual aggregate liability cap with uncapped Excluded Claims after Section 16.5
